description: Searches every Milwaukee business record Little Milwaukee holds by name, listed or not: businesses from City of Milwaukee license and property data and other public sources, each with its facts and their sources, methods and check dates. Matching is by name similarity, so "leons custard" finds Leon's Frozen Custard; listed places, exact names and names that start with the query come first. Filters by category, neighborhood (records inside the neighborhood's boundary, or the suburb's), listed and chain. Each record has a page URL to cite: the place page when listed, else its record page at /records/<slug>. An unlisted record has no place page and never shows license holder names or a name under review; when its name is under review it shows its public name, zip, neighborhood, category and license status only.

category.description: Only records in this category slug or its subcategories. list_categories returns the slugs.

chain.description: true for chains and franchises only, false to leave them out.

limit.description: How many records to return, default 10; values above 50 return 50.

listed.description: true for records with a Little Milwaukee page only, false for unlisted records only.

neighborhood.description: Only records in this neighborhood or suburb slug, for example riverwest or wauwatosa: inside its boundary, or the canon neighborhood of a listed place.

query.description: The business name or part of it, for example "tracks tavern".

name: search_records
